permit.applies: the worker, at the Migration Service headquarters in Dili or an embassy or consulate abroad
permit.first: a certified copy of the working or service contract and the sponsoring company's or organisation's tax payment certificate

fees.what: Temporary Stay Visa, initial application or extension

permit.eligibility: Will engage in legitimate specialized activities, including cultural, sporting, scientific research, journalistic or highly qualified activities as an artist, sportsman, researcher, foreign media correspondent, or highly qualified technician

sources.title: Serviço de Migração de Timor-Leste, Temporary Stay Visa
sources.said: Specialized activities, including cultural, sporting, scientific research, journalistic or highly qualified activities as an artist, sportsman, researcher, foreign media correspondent, or highly qualified technician; … The fee for initial application and any extension is US$50, payable in cash at the time of application. … Will engage in legitimate specialized activities, including cultural, sporting, scientific research, journalistic or highly qualified activities as an artist, sportsman, researcher, foreign media correspondent, or highly qualified technician … Certified copy of the working/service contract Qualification/s or other evidence of professional skills Tax payment certificate of the sponsoring company or organization … If engaged in specialized activities, valid for the contract or mission period up to a maximum of one year, which may be extended for equal periods. Work of the specified type with the specified employer or sponsor is permitted.

note: The Migration Service's Temporary Stay Visa covers specialised activities, cultural ones among them, 'as an artist': applied for at the Migration Service in Dili or an embassy, US$50 for the first application or any extension, on a certified working or service contract and the sponsor's tax certificate; valid for the contract or mission, at most a year, extendable for equal periods; work of the specified type for the specified sponsor only. No decision time is stated; no union step, minimum pay or exempt days.
